page.content:
Warrior power that shifts from foe to uneasy ally.

How Klingon Empire connects

  • Character: Worf — Worf is a Klingon who also serves Starfleet.
  • Faction: Starfleet — Early Starfleet treats the Klingon Empire as its great rival.

What is Klingon Empire?

The Klingon Empire is the honor-bound rival of early Starfleet, later a Federation ally whose culture Worf carries onto the Enterprise-D.

Key threads lead to Worf and Starfleet.
